seo__search_description: Self-referral, family referral, or professional referral to Oakdene House Foundation. We'll be in touch within 2 business days.
hero__title: Make a referral to Oakdene House
hero__intro: Self-referral, family referral, or professional referral — we'll be in touch within 2 business days.
main_column__intro: This form is for anyone referring someone to Oakdene — whether you're referring yourself, a family member, or a client as a professional worker. Complete the form below and our team will review your referral and be in touch within 2 business days. If the situation is urgent, please also call us on [(02) 8717 0999](tel:0287170999).
main_column__intro_2: *Everything you share is confidential and handled in line with our [privacy policy](/privacy-policy/).*
sidebar__text: If you or someone else is in crisis right now, please don't wait for this referral to be processed. Visit our [Need Help Now page](/need-help-now/) for 24-hour crisis support lines.
sidebar__text_2: Our team is available during business hours to take your call.
cta__heading: Not sure if you need a referral?
cta__subheading: Contact us directly and we'll help you work out the best way to access support.
